Try itShape the move with \(q(u)\): how much of \(\Delta d\) is done at \(u\)

  • \(u\) is the share of the distance \(L\) covered.
  • \(q(u)\) is a formula: give it \(u\), and it returns the share of the sideways move \(\Delta d\) done.
  • \(q(u) = 10u^{3} - 15u^{4} + 6u^{5}\)

\(u\)try it
  1. \(u = 0\): \(q = 0\). None of the move is done.
  2. \(u = 0.25\): \(q = 0.156 - 0.059 + 0.006 = 0.10\). A quarter of the distance, a tenth of the move: a slow start.
  3. \(u = 0.5\): \(q = 1.25 - 0.9375 + 0.1875 = 0.5\). Halfway, half the move.
  4. \(u = 0.75\): \(q = 4.219 - 4.746 + 1.424 = 0.90\).
  5. \(u = 1\): \(q = 10 - 15 + 6 = 1\). The whole move.
